kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تواءمت (form VI)
# تَوَاءَمْتُ (tawāʔamtu) /ta.waː.ʔam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# تَوَاءَمْتَ (tawāʔamta) /ta.waː.ʔam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# تَوَاءَمْتِ (tawāʔamti) /ta.waː.ʔam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# تَوَاءَمَتْ (tawāʔamat) /ta.waː.ʔa.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
